about: AI-contribution labels for Open Source Everything, prepared 2026-10-27 by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) from each project's own contributing guide, AI policy and pull-request template. Every entry is AI-prepared ("temp AI marker"): a maintainer who claims the project replaces it. Method and caveats: ai-contribution-labels.md.

mapping.non-developers-welcome: Non-developers welcome. AI-assisted or AI-generated code is accepted, and the conditions are ones a non-developer can meet: say you used AI, test the change yourself, follow the normal quality and size rules. The policy does not require you to understand or explain every line.
mapping.traditional-developers-only: Traditional Developers Only. AI tools may be used, but you must understand, test and be able to explain or defend every change yourself (developer-level responsibility); or the project bars AI-written code from newcomers.
mapping.not-accepted: Not Accepted. AI-generated code is refused: either all AI-written code, or pull requests that are wholly, mostly or primarily AI-generated (AI as a small helper may still be tolerated; the description says so).
mapping.see-policy: See Policy. Only for rules that genuinely do not fit the three labels above (for example, AI allowed only from specific kinds of AI model).
mapping.None: No label (empty state). No AI policy was found; maintainers can set one after claiming the project. Rules only about issues, bug reports or descriptions still get a main label for code, with the partial rule in the description.

outsideHelpValues.welcomes-prs: Send a pull request (the guide explains how and sets no "ask first" rule).
outsideHelpValues.issue-first: Open or claim an issue and get agreement before sending code.
outsideHelpValues.not-accepting: Not taking outside code right now.
outsideHelpValues.null: Not stated / no contributing guide found.

scopeRule: Big/important = Verified, OR >=5,000 GitHub stars, OR top 3 by the site ranking (site/src/rank.mjs, no votes) in any group, OR hosted off GitHub. Everything else is listed in notFilled.
